title: 孤城逐晓 · 封闭测试
description: 四人协作塔防与生存。建造城防、培养英雄，应对不断增强的怪物波次，并挑战无尽模式。本条目用于受限测试，暂不开放真实付费。
notes: Updates the original private test item; visibility remains private and no new Workshop item is created.
Both signed runtime and isolated API restrict the four owner-confirmed Steam accounts. A whitelist is not a substitute for trusted server authentication.
The owner selected independent test saves on 2026-10-23. No existing player profiles, orders or balances were copied; existing archive/payment services remain unchanged.

The dedicated Valve server obtains its credential at runtime. The backend stays closed until the owner confirms the displayed pairing fingerprint; no shared credential is included in downloadable code.
Only six runtime files differ from the frozen v02 release, including two new transport modules; all gameplay/resources and 180 protected modules are preserved.
Four authorized account authentication and fifth-account/anonymous/unregistered rejection passed against the isolated database; actual Valve pairing and full match entry remain separate checks.

WS4-02 preserves bounded Valve Invalid_* states and distinguishes dedicated-server, credential API, credential format, routing, HTTP rejection and network failures. No authentication check is bypassed; Japan match entry is not yet verified.

WS4-03 queries GetDedicatedServerKeyV3 independently of the generic IsDedicatedServer flag. All invalid-key, HTTPS, four-account and owner-confirmed pin requirements remain; actual Valve result and match entry are unverified.
